title: Detailed drum
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum shell -->
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="60" height="50" rx="3" fill="#d62828"/>
  <!-- shell highlight stripe -->
  <rect x="20" y="44" width="60" height="4" fill="#f77f00"/>
  <rect x="20" y="60" width="60" height="4" fill="#f77f00"/>
  <!-- shell darker edge left -->
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="5" height="50" fill="#a01d1d" rx="1"/>
  <!-- shell darker edge right -->
  <rect x="75" y="30" width="5" height="50" fill="#a01d1d" rx="1"/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="32" ry="10" fill="#f4e285"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#2d3142"/>
  <!-- top head skin -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="31" rx="26" ry="7" fill="#f7f3e3"/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="32" ry="10" fill="#f4e285"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#2d3142"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="81" rx="26" ry="7" fill="#f7f3e3"/>
  <!-- lug casing left top -->
  <rect x="22" y="33" width="6" height="14" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="24" y="36" width="2" height="8" fill="#e09f3e"/>
  <!-- lug casing right top -->
  <rect x="72" y="33" width="6" height="14" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="74" y="36" width="2" height="8" fill="#e09f3e"/>
  <!-- lug casing left bottom -->
  <rect x="22" y="63" width="6" height="14" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="24" y="66" width="2" height="8" fill="#e09f3e"/>
  <!-- lug casing right bottom -->
  <rect x="72" y="63" width="6" height="14" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="74" y="66" width="2" height="8" fill="#e09f3e"/>
  <!-- tension rods -->
  <line x1="25" y1="33" x2="25" y2="80" stroke="#c0c0c0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="33" x2="75" y2="80" stroke="#c0c0c0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- center lug top -->
  <rect x="46" y="28" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="48" y="30" width="4" height="2" fill="#e09f3e"/>
  <!-- center lug bottom -->
  <rect x="46" y="76" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <rect x="48" y="78" width="4" height="2" fill="#e09f3e"/>
  <!-- drumstick left -->
  <line x1="35" y1="18" x2="48" y2="35" stroke="#e8b87a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="18" r="3" fill="#d4a373"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="35" r="2" fill="#f7f3e3"/>
  <!-- drumstick right -->
  <line x1="65" y1="15" x2="52" y2="33" stroke="#e8b87a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="15" r="3" fill="#d4a373"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="33" r="2" fill="#f7f3e3"/>
  <!-- sparkle accents -->
  <polygon points="15,22 17,26 21,27 17,28 15,32 13,28 9,27 13,26" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <polygon points="85,55 86,57 88,58 86,59 85,61 84,59 82,58 84,57" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
